caption.text:
We’re quick to call it bad luck. The missed exit. The delayed flight. The plan that falls apart at the last second. We see inconvenience — but what if it’s intervention? What if the delay is protection you can’t see yet? 

Not every setback is meant to stop you. Some are meant to steer you. Some are quietly moving you away from something that would have cost you more than you realize. 

Trust that where you end up is not random. Even the burnt toast has a purpose. 

Inspired by the book ‘Let Go, Trust God’ by Rebecca Simon 📖 Find it by following the link in the bio.
